capabilities: Set a display name for each vault
Replace the vault switcher menu with aliased names
Rename the vault label and window title
Store a vault's own alias in vault-alias.json
Keep one shared alias file outside all vaults
disambiguation: Not note aliases in frontmatter; it only changes the displayed name of whole vaults, not folders or paths.
extras: Desktop only and relies on Obsidian internals that are not public API, so an Obsidian update can break it; disabling the plugin restores Obsidian's own behaviour. Installed by copying main.js and manifest.json into each vault. Tested on Windows and Linux, not on macOS.
problem: Obsidian names every vault after its folder, so vaults whose folders share a name such as Documentation or Notes look identical in the vault switcher.
summary: Desktop plugin that shows user-chosen display names for vaults in the vault switcher, the vault name label and the window title.
